# Phase 3 — Project pins, clone, export/import

[GENESIS §14 Phase 3](GENESIS.md). Adds `.maru` project pin discovery,
profile cloning, profile import/export tarballs (with credential
deny-list), and import-existing for migrating real `~/.claude` etc.
into a maru profile.

Exit criteria (GENESIS §14):

- `cd repo-with-.maru; claude` activates the pinned profile without any user shell state.
- `maru profile export work --to /tmp/work.tar.gz && tar tzf /tmp/work.tar.gz` shows zero matching deny-list patterns.

## Tasks

- [x] **3.1** — `maru-store::deny_list` module + `maru-store::copy::copy_filtered` walker. 6 + 3 tests cover claude/codex/gemini per-file patterns and universal `keychain` substring.
- [x] **3.2** — `maru profile pin <name>` (idempotent rewrite, refuses overwrite without `--force`) + `maru profile unpin`.
- [x] **3.3** — `maru profile clone <from> <to>` deep-copies via `copy_filtered` per harness; e2e verifies `.credentials.json` is excluded.
- [x] **3.4** — `maru profile export <name> --to <path>` tarballs a filtered staging dir + an `.maru-manifest.json` with version + harness list. e2e verifies `tar tzf` shows zero deny-list matches.
- [x] **3.5** — `maru profile import <archive> [--name <profile>]` reads the manifest, extracts, registers in state.toml. e2e verifies round-trip drops credentials.
- [x] **3.6** — `maru profile import-existing --harness <id> [--name <profile>] [--from <path>]` defaults to `~/.<harness>`; copies via `copy_filtered`; lists excluded files in stderr.
- [x] **3.7** — `docs/direnv.md` covers `.maru` vs `.envrc`, resolution precedence, IDE-extension-host pitfall.
- [x] **3.8** — Shim `.maru`-walking resolution was already implemented in Phase 1 (`walk_for_pin` in `crates/maru-shim/src/main.rs`). The new `pin_writes_dot_maru_in_cwd` e2e test exercises the CLI side; the shim side is covered by `walk_for_pin_*` unit tests in maru-shim.
